zh_sentense: 我们举办班级告别联欢会。

name: 祝福寄语
en_sentense: I write warm blessings to every deskmate.
zh_sentense: 我给每位同桌写下暖心祝福。

name: 珍惜
en_sentense: Cherish every remaining day in primary school.
zh_sentense: 珍惜小学剩余每一天时光。

name: 纪念性的
en_sentense: This memorial photo stays in my drawer forever.
zh_sentense: 这张纪念照片永远珍藏在我的抽屉里。

name: 分别
en_sentense: We will separate but keep in touch often.
zh_sentense: 我们即将分别，但会时常保持联系。

name: 联络
en_sentense: We use chat software to keep close contact.
zh_sentense: 我们用聊天软件保持紧密联络。

name: 升学规划
en_sentense: Make a detailed schedule plan for junior high study.
zh_sentense: 为初中学习制定详细规划。

name: 适应
en_sentense: Prepare early for the adaptation to new school life.
zh_sentense: 提早准备适应全新校园生活。

name: 课程体系
en_sentense: The junior high curriculum adds several new subjects.
zh_sentense: 初中课程体系新增好几门科目。

name: 作业量
en_sentense: We should get ready for heavier homework load ahead.
zh_sentense: 我们要提前适应更大的作业量。

name: 自我管理
en_sentense: Good self-management benefits middle school study greatly.
zh_sentense: 优秀的自我管理对初中学习助力很大。

name: 压力
en_sentense: Learn to release study stress in healthy ways.
zh_sentense: 学会用健康方式释放学习压力。

name: 放松调剂
en_sentense: Reading and walking are good relaxation methods.
zh_sentense: 阅读、散步都是不错的放松方式。

name: 心理健康
en_sentense: Pay constant attention to your own mental health.
zh_sentense: 时刻关注自身心理健康状态。

name: 体育锻炼
en_sentense: Stick to daily physical exercise to stay energetic.
zh_sentense: 坚持每日锻炼，保持精力充沛。

name: 营养膳食
en_sentense: Keep a balanced nutritious diet every day.
zh_sentense: 每日保持均衡营养膳食。

name: 作息周期
en_sentense: Form a regular sleep cycle before entering middle school.
zh_sentense: 升入初中前养成规律作息周期。

name: 生活技能
en_sentense: Master basic life skills before living on your own.
zh_sentense: 独立生活前掌握基础生活技能。

name: 洗衣
en_sentense: I learn to do my own laundry on weekends.
zh_sentense: 周末我学着自己洗衣服。

name: 整理房间
en_sentense: Tidy my own bedroom every evening.
zh_sentense: 每晚整理自己的卧室。

name: 简易烹饪
en_sentense: I can cook simple dishes for my family.
zh_sentense: 我能为家人做几道简单家常菜。

name: 零花钱管理
en_sentense: Do simple budget management for pocket money.
zh_sentense: 对零花钱做简单收支管理。

name: 消费习惯
en_sentense: Build a reasonable and moderate consumption habit.
zh_sentense: 建立理性适度的消费习惯。

name: 目标设定
en_sentense: Goal setting makes learning more directional.
zh_sentense: 设定目标让学习更有方向感。

name: 自我复盘反思
en_sentense: Do weekly self-reflection on study gains and shortcomings.
zh_sentense: 每周复盘学习收获与不足。

name: 知识体系
en_sentense: Sort out a complete knowledge system for primary school.
zh_sentense: 梳理完整的小学知识体系。

name: 应试策略
en_sentense: Summarize a suitable exam strategy for final tests.
zh_sentense: 总结适配期末考试的应试策略。

name: 考场时间分配
en_sentense: Practice reasonable time allocation in simulated exams.
zh_sentense: 模拟考试中练习合理分配答题时间。

name: 检查答案
en_sentense: Spare several minutes to check answers after finishing the paper.
zh_sentense: 试卷做完预留几分钟检查答案。

name: 书写工整度
en_sentense: Keep handwriting neat to avoid unnecessary point loss.
zh_sentense: 保持字迹工整，避免无谓失分。

name: 国际视野
en_sentense: Read widely to open up your global vision.
zh_sentense: 广泛阅读，开阔国际视野。

name: 文化自信
en_sentense: We build strong cultural confidence from traditional culture.
zh_sentense: 我们从传统文化中树立坚定文化自信。

name: 追逐梦想
en_sentense: Keep moving forward firmly in dream pursuit.
zh_sentense: 追逐梦想，稳步前行不动摇。

name: 少年志向
en_sentense: Set lofty youth aspirations for future growth.
zh_sentense: 树立远大少年志向，奔赴未来成长之路。

name: 新征程
en_sentense: Graduation is the start of a brand new journey.
zh_sentense: 毕业只是一段全新征程的起点。
